outfit.name: 应龙特勤玄黑长衣（默认）
outfit.prose: A black Yinglung Special Task Force tactical outfit featuring a structured high collar, a fitted black zipper top, a slit tactical front skirt with utility belt pouches, an open long black coat lined in aqua teal with armored wide cuffs, black tactical gloves, and crimson segmented thigh-high boots.
